summary: E2E verification of iteration 8 Fikirizm Cloud changes: (A) Project Delete bug fix via ProjectSettings danger zone, (B) Dashboard 'Proje İlerlemesi' panel, (C) Activity page single-column + time-range filter. All three verified PASS end-to-end. Permission gating for delete verified. Regression clean.
verified_features: PROJECT DELETE (primary bug): Owner login → created throwaway 'SilTest QA' via [data-testid=add-project-btn] using project-name-input → navigated to project → clicked project-settings-btn → danger zone visible with project-delete-btn → clicked → project-delete-confirm-btn appeared → clicked → toast 'Proje silindi' shown, dialog closed, redirected to /panel. Sidebar entry gone, and dashboard 'Proje İlerlemesi' no longer lists SilTest QA. GET-side confirmed via UI listing.

PROJECT DELETE permission: Non-privileged member (mert@fikirizm.com) navigated to 'Ürün Geliştirme' — [data-testid=project-settings-btn] NOT present (False) and [data-testid=project-delete-btn] NOT present (False). Gating verified in code at ProjectPage.jsx L98 (isPrivileged) and L288 (delete inside same gated dialog).

DASHBOARD PROGRESS PANEL: [data-testid=project-progress] visible with 5 rows. 'Ürün Geliştirme' shows 17%, '1 geciken' badge, '1/6 tamam · 5 açık'. Clicking [data-testid=progress-prj_e7fa4c4d8e8c4a64] navigated to /proje/prj_e7fa4c4d8e8c4a64 correctly. Sorting by overdue-first observed.

ACTIVITY PAGE: /aktivite renders single-column list. [data-testid=activity-time-filter] and [data-testid=activity-filter] present. Rows before filter: 14. Selecting 'Bugün' → 12 rows (filter applied). Then combining with an action-type filter ('bütçe kalemi ekledi') → 7 rows. No crash. Newest-first ordering visible ('1 saat önce' → '5 saat önce').

REGRESSION: Login OK for both owner and member. Sidebar renders. Dashboard hero + metric tiles render. Kanban (Pano) view opens for member on Ürün Geliştirme. Only console noise: pre-existing WS 403 (known env issue) and 2x 401 on /me while on /giris page (pre-existing cosmetic). No blocking errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py delete_project correctly enforces is_privileged (403) and cascades delete of tasks + budget_items. Also broadcasts WS. Good.

delete_project does NOT delete activities for the deleted project — orphan activities remain until _backfill_activity_projects cleanup on next restart. Consider explicit cleanup here (also for ideas/comments/files if any). Minor; not blocking.

Dashboard project_progress correctly filters by accessible_project_ids and sorts by (-overdue, -open, pct). Includes empty projects (0/0) — 'Operasyon (Gizli)' shows 0/0 · 0 açık which may be noisy in UI; consider hiding zero-task projects or last-place sort. Minor UX.
ProjectPage.jsx: both settings + delete gated behind isPrivileged in-frontend. Two-step confirm (setConfirmDel state) is a reasonable pattern; server also enforces 403 so defence-in-depth is fine.
AppData bootstrap invalidation on delete works: sidebar sync after delete verified (immediate — not waiting for 20s polling).
